eventDetail.eventTitle: 2026 8th International Conference on Robotics and Computer Vision (ICRCV)
eventDetail.about: Computing and Processing; Robotics and Control Systems
eventDetail.sponsors: IEEE Robotics and Automation Society; Nanjing University of Science and Technology - China
eventDetail.keywords: Robot Design and Control, Intelligent Control Systems and Engineering Applications, Artificial  Intelligence in Robot Systems, Machine Vision and Visualization, Robotics in Biomedicine and  Rehabilitation,
eventDetail.scope: The conference will cover a wide range of important topics, including but not limited to: robot control, microrobotics and micromanipulation technologies, robot perception and data fusion, image/video analysis, image-based modeling and recognition, and other cutting-edge advancements. In addition to keynote and invited speeches, the conference will feature oral presentations and poster sessions, providing a comprehensive platform for the exchange and display of the latest research findings.
